**Implementation note:** The s-score is built on ETF residuals; Avellaneda-Lee's PCA factor variant is not.

## Description

Estimate common market/sector factors via principal components and trade idiosyncratic residual deviations.

## Where it may fit

Large, liquid equity universes with stable common-factor structure and transient residual moves.

## Vehicles

Equity market-neutral/statistical-arbitrage funds.

## Required data

Point-in-time stock prices, factor universe, PCA loadings, corporate actions, borrow costs and high-quality execution data.

## Caveats

Sensitive to universe construction, estimation windows, trading costs and crowding.
